guides.name: Heart Gore burst PvP — Game8

$join.$t: PvP-гайд из интернета, не с Questlog: {site}, автор {author}. Собран помощником по статье — сверяйтесь с оригиналом.

$join: A single-target burst build for endgame PvP. Buff with Swift Contract and Illusive Clone, open with a Shadowstrike stun from behind, then hold a right-click macro of Insignia Explosion and Heart Gore. Heart Gore, Quick Slice and Insignia Explosion are levelled first; manastones go into PvP accuracy, PvP damage and back-attack damage.

rotation: Pop Swift Contract and Illusive Clone before anything else.

tips.title: Buffs first
tips.text: Swift Contract and Illusive Clone are the damage window of this build. Use them before you start spamming the macro; putting both on one key makes it easy.

tips.title: Macro delay
tips.text: Set the macro delay to roughly half of your ping.

tips.title: Staying behind the target
tips.text: Flash Slice and Infiltrate close gaps and put you behind the target; Shadow Walk lets you sneak up on unaware players while your skills recover.

tips.title: One target at a time
tips.text: The build is made to pick off single targets from behind. Choose an isolated enemy and focus it down instead of spreading damage.

tips.title: Levelling order
tips.text: Push Heart Gore, Quick Slice and Insignia Explosion to 20 first, on skills and on Daevanion boards; most other actives can stay low.

guides.name: Stealth control PvP — Fextralife

$join.$t: PvP-гайд из интернета, не с Questlog: {site}, автор {author}. Собран помощником по статье — сверяйтесь с оригиналом.

$join: A skirmish and duel build: open from stealth, chain a stun into a knockdown, then stack five Insignias for a guaranteed Aerial Bind and detonate them. Stigmas are Shadow Walk, Illusive Clone, Aerial Bind and Evasion Contract, with Defiance and Evasion Contract kept for breaking control. Accuracy comes first, then PvP Damage Tolerance and Status Effect Resist.

rotation: Open from stealth: Shadow Walk, Shadowstrike stun, Shadow Fall knockdown.
If the stun misses, Blind with Flash Slice or Infiltrate and Shadow Fall anyway (Shadow Fall 16).
Stack 5 Insignias with Savage Roar and back-attack Ambush, then Aerial Bind for a sure Airborne and Insignia Explosion to finish.
Use Illusive Clone only once the target is locked in CC.

tips.title: When Shadow Fall works
tips.text: Shadow Fall needs a Stunned target, or a Blinded one with the level 16 option. Knockdown and Airborne do not enable it.

tips.title: Aerial Bind needs 5 Insignias
tips.text: With fewer stacks Airborne is a coin flip, so build all five Insignias before casting Aerial Bind.

tips.title: Storm Rampage in PvP
tips.text: Storm Rampage only hits Staggered targets, so it does little against players.

tips.title: Respect enemy Defiance
tips.text: When the opponent uses Defiance, back off and wait out their Tenacity before spending more control on them.

tips.title: Long brawls
tips.text: For extended arena fights swap Shadow Walk for Evasion Stance: an extra charge at level 5 and casting on the move at level 10.

guides.name: Arena & Abyss PvP — ExpCarry

$join.$t: PvP-гайд из интернета, не с Questlog: {site}, автор {author}. Собран помощником по статье — сверяйтесь с оригиналом.

$join: Two PvP presets: Arena / 1v1 with Illusive Clone, Triniel's Dagger, Shadowstep and Spiral Slice, and Abyss / group PvP with Shadow Walk and Throw Shadowblade instead. Specializations favour longer stuns and knockdowns, shield break and reliable crits; Azphel goes to Status Effect Chance first, then PvP Damage Tolerance. Fight from behind, control first and burst only inside a safe stun window.

combat.openerNote: Pick a target its team is not covering and come in from a good angle, from Stealth if you can.

manual.when: When the target survives and turns on you: disengage.
Against buffed targets: strips buffs and stuns if it removes two or more.
During the burst: a hit cuts your cooldowns.

combat.notes: The article gives no macro: keep movement and defensive skills on manual keys.

rotation: Pick a target that is not covered by its team and approach from a good angle, in Stealth if possible.
Shadowstrike to get behind and control, Shadow Fall while the stun holds.
Build or apply Insignias, then Illusive Clone and your damage skills while the target is helpless.
Detonate with Insignia Explosion and keep pressing Heart Gore whenever crits reset it.
If the target survives and fights back, leave with Shadowstep.

tips.title: Control can fail
tips.text: Even at five Insignias, Insignia Explosion has only a base 50% stun chance on players. Have a backup plan before you commit.

tips.title: Defence stays manual
tips.text: Keep movement and defensive skills on their own keys instead of putting them in a macro.

tips.title: Arena stigmas
tips.text: Do not take the PvE stigma set into Arena: Shadowstep and Spiral Slice bring the control and escape a duel needs.

tips.title: Abyss preset
tips.text: For Abyss and group PvP swap to Shadow Walk and Throw Shadowblade. Stats then shift to Accuracy, PvP Damage Tolerance, Status Effect Resist and HP.

tips.title: Choosing targets in the Abyss
tips.text: Hunt isolated or distracted players, commit from a flank and leave before their group reacts. Do not dive a protected target.

tips.title: Getting controlled first
tips.text: If you keep getting controlled before you can act, Status Effect Resist helps more than a little extra Attack.
